title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #10

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which hand do we use to hold the siwak? (1 mark)
   A. Left hand only
   B. Neither
   C. Right hand
   D. Both feet

2. Why do Muslims believe in all the prophets? (1 mark)
   A. They are all angels
   B. They were all sent by Allah with the same basic message
   C. They all lived in Makkah
   D. They were all kings

3. Who does the hadith in Muslim say is better and more beloved to Allah? (1 mark)
   A. The rich person
   B. The tall person
   C. The strong believer
   D. The weak believer

4. What did the angel of the mountains offer? (1 mark)
   A. To carry him
   B. To bring food
   C. To bring rain
   D. To crush the people between two mountains

5. Another name for the Angel of Death is (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Izrail
   C. Mikail
   D. Israfil

6. Which example is a light najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Blood
   B. Dog saliva
   C. Urine of a baby boy who feeds only on milk
   D. Urine of an adult

7. What do we say when entering the house? (1 mark)
   A. Only Amin
   B. Subhanallah
   C. Tawakkaltu 'alallah
   D. Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna

8. How can we honour the early converts? (1 mark)
   A. Forget them
   B. Insult them
   C. Learn their stories and copy their qualities
   D. Ignore them

9. What does "Allahu Akbar" mean? (1 mark)
   A. All praise belongs to Allah
   B. Glory to Allah
   C. Allah is the Greatest
   D. Allah is One

10. Which virtue is needed if a classmate teases you? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. Patience and tolerance
   C. Revenge
   D. Fighting

11. Which job did the young Muhammad (S.A.W.) do? (1 mark)
   A. Shepherd and later trader
   B. Soldier
   C. Blacksmith only
   D. Judge

12. Why does Al-Falaq teach us to seek refuge from envy? (1 mark)
   A. Envy brings prayer
   B. Envy is a game
   C. Envy is a harmful feeling and only Allah can protect us
   D. Envy makes people rich

13. Which verse says "Call upon Me, I will respond to you"? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:3
   B. Qur'an 40:60
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 1:1

14. What does the command "Iqra" teach us? (1 mark)
   A. Only pray
   B. Stay silent
   C. Avoid books
   D. Seek knowledge

15. What should you do if a stranger online asks for your address? (1 mark)
   A. Give it
   B. Refuse and tell an adult
   C. Tell friends
   D. Send a photo

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What do we say in ruku, in sujud and when sitting between the two sujud? (3 marks)

17. When must a child not obey a parent, and how should the child still behave? (3 marks)

18. What can a person say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (2 marks)

19. Choose any two prophets and explain one virtue from the life of each. (5 marks)

20. Give two good habits that keep a toothbrush healthy. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Right hand
   The right hand is used for clean, honourable actions.

2. B — They were all sent by Allah with the same basic message
   Islam makes no difference in belief.

3. C — The strong believer
   Both have good, but the strong believer is more beloved.

4. D — To crush the people between two mountains
   The Prophet refused.

5. B — Izrail
   Izrail is commonly used for Malakul Maut.

6. C — Urine of a baby boy who feeds only on milk
   Light najasa is cleaned by sprinkling.

7. D — Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna
   This is the dua for entering.

8. C — Learn their stories and copy their qualities
   Imitate their good deeds.

9. C — Allah is the Greatest
   Takbir means Allah is the Greatest.

10. B — Patience and tolerance
   Stay calm.

11. A — Shepherd and later trader
   He herded sheep and later traded honestly.

12. C — Envy is a harmful feeling and only Allah can protect us
   The fifth verse asks protection from the envier when he envies.

13. B — Qur'an 40:60
   Surah Ghafir 40:60.

14. D — Seek knowledge
   Islam values knowledge.

15. B — Refuse and tell an adult
   Strangers can be unsafe.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ruku: Subhana Rabbiyal Azim; sujud: Subhana Rabbiyal A'la; sitting: Rabbighfir li.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: When a parent commands something Allah forbids. The child should still treat them kindly and politely.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the case, 1 mark for not obeying, 1 mark for kindness.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: "Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu" meaning "In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for the meaning.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ayyub showed patience in illness; Ibrahim showed generosity to guests.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each prophet, 1 mark for each virtue, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not share it and change it when the bristles are bent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.
